ayahs.2: Khada ho ja aur aagaah kar de.
ayahs.3: Aur apne Rabb hi ki badaaiyan bayan kar.
ayahs.4: Apne kapdon ko paak rakha kar.
ayahs.6: Aur ehsaan karke zyada lene ki khwahish na kar.
ayahs.7: Aur apne Rabb ki raah mein sabr kar.
ayahs.8: Pas jab ke soor mein phoonk maari jaayegi.
ayahs.9: To woh din bada sakht din hoga.
ayahs.10: Jo kaafiron par aasan na hoga.
ayahs.11: Mujhe aur use chhod de jise main ne akela paida kiya hai.
ayahs.12: Aur use bahut sa maal de rakha hai.
ayahs.14: Aur main ne use bahut kuchh kushaadagi de rakhi hai.
ayahs.15: Phir bhi us ki chaahat hai ke main use aur zyada doon.
ayahs.16: Nahin nahin, woh hamari aayaton ka mukhaalif hai.
ayahs.17: Anqareeb main use ek sakht chadhaai chadhaoonga.
ayahs.18: Us ne ghaur karke tajweez ki.
ayahs.20: Woh phir ghaarat ho, kis tarah andaaza kiya.
ayahs.22: Phir tewri chadhaai aur munh banaya.
ayahs.23: Phir peechhe hat gaya aur ghuroor kiya.
ayahs.24: Aur kehne laga tu, yeh sirf jaadu hai jo naql kiya jaata hai.
ayahs.25: Siwaye insaani kalaam ke kuchh bhi nahin hai.
ayahs.26: Main anqareeb use dozakh mein daalonga.
ayahs.27: Aur tujhe kya khabar ke dozakh kya cheez hai?
ayahs.28: Na woh baaqi rakhti hai na chhodti hai.
ayahs.30: Aur is mein unnees (farishte muqarrar) hain.
ayahs.31: Hum ne dozakh ke daroghe sirf farishte rakhe hain. Aur hum ne un ki tadaad sirf kaafiron ki aazmaish ke liye muqarrar ki hai taake ahl-e-kitab yaqeen kar len, aur ahl-e-imaan ke imaan mein izaafa ho jaaye aur ahl-e-kitab aur ahl-e-imaan shak na karen, aur jin ke dilon mein beemari hai woh aur kaafir kahen ke is bayan se Allah Taala ki kya muraad hai? Isi tarah Allah Taala jise chaahta hai gumrah karta hai aur jise chaahta hai hidayat deta hai. Tere Rabb ke lashkaron ko is ke siwa koi nahin jaanta, yeh to kull bani Aadam ke liye saraasar pand-o-naseehat hai.
ayahs.32: Sach kehta hoon, qasam hai chaand ki.
ayahs.33: Aur raat ki jab woh peechhe hate.
ayahs.34: Aur subah ki jab ke roshan ho jaaye.
ayahs.35: Ke (yaqeenan woh jahannam) badi cheezon mein se ek hai.
ayahs.37: (Yani) use jo tum mein se aage badhna chaahe ya peechhe hatna chaahe.
ayahs.38: Har shakhs apne aamaal ke badle mein girwi hai.
ayahs.40: Ke woh bahishton mein (baithe hue) gunahgaaron se.
ayahs.42: Tumhein dozakh mein kis cheez ne daala.
ayahs.43: Woh jawaab denge ke hum namaazi na the.
ayahs.44: Na miskeenon ko khaana khilaate the.
ayahs.45: Aur hum behas karne walon (inkaariyon) ka saath de kar behas-o-mubaahisa mein mashghool raha karte the.
ayahs.47: Yahan tak ke hamein maut aa gayi.
ayahs.48: Pas unhein sifarish karne walon ki sifarish nafa na degi.
ayahs.49: Unhein kya ho gaya hai ke naseehat se munh mod rahe hain.
ayahs.50: Goya ke woh bidke hue gadhe hain.
ayahs.52: Balke un mein se har shakhs chaahta hai ke use khuli hui kitaaben di jaaen.
ayahs.53: Hargiz aisa nahin (ho sakta balke) yeh qayamat se be-khauf hain.
ayahs.54: Sachi baat to yeh hai ke yeh (Quran) ek naseehat hai.
ayahs.55: Ab jo chaahe is se naseehat haasil kare.
ayahs.56: Aur woh us waqt naseehat haasil karenge jab Allah Taala chaahe, woh isi laayaq hai ke is se daren aur is laayaq bhi ke woh bakhshe.
